title: Component maps for a cochain realization
statement: For a scheme X, module sheaves F,G and a computing resolution pairing D, there are degree maps from the tensor total complex to the target extended complex satisfying the section formula on every nonnegative bidegree and the signed chain equation.

proof.text: Linearize each sectionwise bilinear pairing through the sheaf tensor universal property, assemble the degree maps by the total coproduct universal property, and verify the chain equation from Leibniz, extending negative degrees by zero.
